newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA LIISING CONSOLIDATED PROFIT DOWN IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: HANSA LIISING CONSOLIDATED PROFIT DOWN IN APRIL.

text.p: Hansa Liising, the leasing arm of Estonia's Hansapank , had a consolidated net profit of 4.7 million kroons in April compared to 10.3 million kroons in March, Hansapank said on Wednesday.
During the first four months of 1997 Hansa Liising earned a consolidated net profit of 25.7 million kroons, it added in a statement.
Hansa Liising's profit was 22.1 million kroons and its Latvian subsidiary, Hanza Lizings, had a profit of 3.3 million kroons.
Hansa Liising's consolidated assets were 1.7 billion kroons, up 11.2 percent during the month.
Hansa Liising Estonia's assets were 1.656 billion kroons, Hanza Lizings' were 282.9 million kroons and Lithuania's Hanza Lizingas assets were 114.7 million kroons.
The group's leasing portfolio was divided as follows: Estonia 75.6 percent, Latvia 12 percent and Lithuania 5.2 percent.
